messages:
Marie Chen: FYI: FidelityMed sent a vendor risk questionnaire and are asking for SOC2 evidence + details on Private deployment KMS + data residency. Need fast answers, they're in legal review and asking for signature timeline.
Aman Patel: Can you drop the file? I can triage the technical asks.
Marie Chen: Uploaded the form here: https://files.redwood.internal/fidelitymed/vendor-form.pdf -- key asks: encryption at rest details, who holds keys, data deletion process, and whether we can provide an on-prem package for audited environments.
Lena Gomez: Hi — security. We have SOC2 Type II report available to share under an NDA. For Private deployments we integrate with customer KMS via standard KMIP / cloud KMS APIs; we also support HSM-backed keys for Dedicated if they require.
Devon Reyes: From infra: Private (VPC) option keeps control plane in customer VPC, but compute can be on-prem or in their cloud. For on-prem we ship the bundle that uses local KMS endpoint. We should confirm supported KMS vendors — currently AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault, and HashiCorp Vault.
Priya Rao: Legal: we'll need to send SOC2 under the NDA and provide a DPA addendum. Timeline: SOC2 copy + redacted evidence can be shared within 1 business day after NDA; DPA signature usually takes 2-3 business days once countersigned by them.
Marie Chen: They specifically asked about key custody: can Redwood *ever* access plaintext keys or data? Need a one-liner for them.
Lena Gomez: One-liner: "Redwood does not have access to customer-managed KMS keys or plaintext when customer-managed keys are configured; key material is stored and controlled by the customer's KMS/HSM. Our optional managed keys are encrypted and rotated per policy, but customers can require BYOK."
Aman Patel: Also they asked about audit logs retention and whether logs contain PII. We scrub tokens and user content from operational logs; audit traces include request metadata (timestamps, model, route) and are retained per the customer's retention policy for Private/Dedicated.
Devon Reyes: Action items: 1) Marie to share NDA link with customer; 2) Lena to prepare the SOC2 redacted package; 3) Legal (Priya) to prepare DPA template; 4) Eng (Aman/Devon) to confirm Vault compatibility matrix and provide the KMS integration doc.
Marie Chen: I'll send NDA now and ping them that we'll follow up with SOC2 + KMS doc tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
onboarding-bot: NDA sent to fidelitymed@example.com — expires in 7 days.
